mode: Read-only proposal; no additional campaign or implementation
literal: DX-08 (plan460): optional correlated smoke, first directed exchange, then an explicitly consented handoff; proof is the observed canonical chain, not text in a model reply.
provider_requirement: No real model/provider requirement in this predicate. These two clients now have a demonstrated direct MCP tool path; a new provider gate would come from M1, not from DX08.

existing_reuse.behavior: Existing versioned reviews, separate consents, request IDs, canonical message reply and claim/result observation. Do not implement a second consent or checkpoint model.

Already proves facade/CLI semantics over real TCP/SQLite with a test helper peer. Missing narrow qualification is replacing the peer/client transport with the two identified distributed clients; the current AC03 test does not perform handoff.

minimal_next_test: Reuse the frozen RestartServer and the two separate client processes. Preserve same synthetic identities/sessions and zero runtime bindings/operations.

Use the existing TerminalCooperation application facade with its existing discover/call port delegated to the distributed Inspector client. The small test bridge selects existing APIs and carries no new JSON-RPC/HTTP implementation. Use the existing checkpoint storage under Temp.
Review and explicitly approve exchange; FastMCP receives the exact directed message and produces a correlated canonical reply through message_create with its own durable client_request_id.
Observe exchange_proven. Request a separate handoff review; assert no handoff before consent and reject the exchange revision as handoff approval. Approve only the exact new handoff review revision.
FastMCP calls handoff_claim on the exact handoff, retains claim_epoch, then handoff_complete with a non-null synthetic result and that epoch. No model is involved.

Facade observe(timeout=0) must report handoff_proven with exact message/handoff/claim/result IDs. Resume/observe must not create a second handoff or identity. Product status may still label retained evidence identities_only; do not modify it to infer future liveness or M1.
Close only owned transports/Server; retain installed XML, client version/module hashes and public canonical IDs, excluding keys/session secrets/body/checkpoint secrets.
scope_choice: The smallest next test qualifies the existing application facade plus these two distributed clients; it must not claim a new standalone CLI credential/launcher qualification. Existing CLI contract tests remain separately cited.
status: Proposed only; qualified_external_client_cooperation remains NOT_RUN until this handoff campaign passes. No product gap identified.
